newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania cen.bank raises one-week rate to 49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania cen.bank raises one-week rate to 49 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Thursday it had raised by one percentage point to 49 percent the minimum permitted rate for its refinancing funds.
It has also cut the amount of one-week funds offered at Thursday's auction by 200 billion lei to 1.35 trillion.
Traders said the moves indicated that the BNR was tightening slightly its monetary policy to help smooth the money market.
Short-term rates sank to about 34 percent from 40 percent a few days ago on a money market saturated with leu funds.
Operators said prices for funds up to one-week might inch up in the coming days to follow the increase of the BNR rate.
Auction results are expected on FXRP later on Thursday or early on Friday. ($=3,430 lei) -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
